name: drill-advisor-app
description: Same-origin React and ASP.NET Core Azure Container Apps application for Drill Advisor.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && dotnet build server/DrillAdvisor.Web/DrillAdvisor.Web.csproj
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && dotnet test server/DrillAdvisor.Web.Tests/DrillAdvisor.Web.Tests.csproj && DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD=Major dotnet test api/DrillAdvisor.Api.Tests/DrillAdvisor.Api.Tests.csproj
